marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 25 knots diminishing to east 15 this afternoon
then backing to north 15 early this evening. Wind increasing to northwest 25
late overnight. Wind northwest 25 Thursday. Snow changing to scattered flurries this evening.
Visibility 1 mile or less in snow. Temperatures near minus 3. Freezing spray beginning Thursday morning. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 2 metres subsiding to 1 late this afternoon then building to
2 Thursday morning.<br/>
